plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for 4RF Aprisa transmission device. It reports uptime, receiver and transmitter temperature, fan, power rail alarm status, and interface traffic (enterprise PEN 14817).
name: Transmission

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Highest 4RF AprisaXE receiver temperature in degrees Celsius, read from aprisaXEReceiverTemperature.

metrics.name: device_fan_state
metrics.description: Worst 4RF AprisaXE fan status, normalized from aprisaXEFan1Status and aprisaXEFan2Status so notFitted(0) and fanOkay(1) are healthy and every other state is abnormal.

metrics.name: device_fan_fan1_state
metrics.description: This metric reports the operational state of the device fan 1, normalized to 1 (normal) or 2 (abnormal).

metrics.name: device_transmitter_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: 4RF AprisaXE transmitter temperature in degrees Celsius, read from aprisaXETransmitterTemperature (1.3.6.1.4.1.14817.7.3.1.2.36.12). Values outside -60 to 150 are dropped; firmware that no longer reports this object produces no series.

metrics.name: device_power_rail_state

dimensions.name: rail
dimensions.description: Power rail (tx_5v / tx_11v / tx_28v / tx_neg5v / rx_12v)

metrics.description: Alarm status of each 4RF AprisaXE power rail: transmitter 5V / 11V / 28V / -5V (aprisaXETransmitter5VPowerStatus, 11VPowerStatus, 28VPowerStatus, Neg5VPowerStatus) and receiver 12V (aprisaXEReceiver12VPowerStatus). FourRFAlarmStatus noAlarm(0) maps to 1 (normal); information, warning, minor, major and critical alarms (1-5) map to 2 (abnormal).

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
